cases.title: Native window opens and backend becomes ready
cases.expected: visible window; backend_ready within 15 s

cases.title: UI element inventory extracted from the live window
cases.expected: non-empty inventory; menus/shortcuts reported as found
cases.actual: QPushButton=10; QComboBox=10; QCheckBox=1; QLineEdit=11; QSpinBox=5; QDoubleSpinBox=2; QSlider=0; QListWidget=3; QTableWidget=2; QTextEdit=3; QTabWidget=0; menus=0; shortcuts=0; dialogs_in_code=2
cases.notes: No menu bar and no keyboard shortcuts exist in the product (reported, not a defect by itself).

cases.title: Mouse navigation across all six pages
cases.expected: pages.currentIndex follows the clicked row
cases.actual: 0:لوحة التحكم=ok; 1:مركز المصادر=ok; 2:قراءات الحساسات=ok; 3:سجل الأحداث=ok; 4:تفاصيل الحدث والتقرير=ok; 5:الإعدادات=ok

cases.title: Source center shows only fields relevant to the selected source
cases.input: select each of the sources in the combo
cases.expected: no simulation settings for real-device sources; each source shows its own fields

cases.title: Simulation sub-options follow mode and family
cases.input: iterate all mode x family combinations
cases.expected: visibility matches the mode (faults, schedule, random settings)

cases.title: Start via button click: source locks, start disabled, values update while navigating
cases.input: click start (simulation NORMAL, 30x, AI on); switch to sensors page
cases.expected: source combo locked, start disabled, sensor values change

cases.title: Stop via button: controls unlock and last data is labeled as stopped
cases.expected: source combo enabled; status says data is last received (not live)
cases.actual: stopped=True status='جاهز — لا يوجد اتصال بالمركبة' running_status='جاهز — لا يوجد اتصال بالمركبة'

cases.title: GUI stays responsive during a 30x session with AI
cases.input: 10 ms QTimer ticks during the session
cases.expected: no gap > 1 s

cases.title: AI status card shows state and model version while running
cases.expected: contains 'AI:' and the model version

cases.title: Second session can start and stop after the first
cases.expected: controls return to idle

cases.title: Double-click an event row opens the report page with a simple report
cases.input: fault run S02 then double-click first event
cases.expected: report page index 4 and non-empty simple report with AI section

cases.title: Technical details button reveals technical report and plot
cases.expected: report_text and time_plot visible

cases.title: English mode contains no leftover Arabic UI text
cases.input: switch to EN, visit every page, scan labels/buttons/combos/lists/headers/tooltips
cases.expected: no Arabic characters in controls (event cells and preserved diagnostic text excluded)

cases.title: Layout direction RTL in Arabic and LTR in English
cases.expected: RTL then LTR

cases.title: Invalid/unreachable network hosts are rejected without crash
cases.expected: an error is shown, window alive
cases.actual: '999.999.1.1'->تعذر إكمال العملية: عنوان الشبكة غير صالح؛ أدخل عنوان IPv4 مثل 127.0.0.1 | 'example.com'->تعذر إكمال العملية: عنوان الشبكة غير صالح؛ أدخل عنوان IPv4 مثل 127.0.0.1 | ''->تعذر إكمال العملية: عنوان الشبكة غير صالح؛ أدخل عنوان IPv4 مثل 127.0.0.1 | '192.168.1.5'->تعذر إكمال العملية: الاتصال الشبكي التجريبي يقبل العنوان المحلي 127.0.0.1 فقط

cases.title: Missing replay file is reported
cases.expected: error label visible
cases.actual: error='تعذر إكمال العملية: الملف غير موجود: does-not-exist.jsonl'

cases.title: Start with replay and no file shows an error
cases.expected: error visible and window alive

cases.title: Window close shuts the backend worker down
cases.expected: worker finished

cases.title: Reopening restores language/theme and previous events
cases.input: new MainWindow on the same DB
cases.expected: language=en theme=dark and the earlier events listed

cases.title: Previous session data is not shown as live after restart
cases.input: read the data-age label after reopening
cases.expected: no live reading claim (no data yet)
cases.actual: age='No reading' context='No session started. Choose simulation in Data sources.'
